title: ENGRAM: From Agent Experience to Weights through Verified Consolidation
title_zh: ENGRAM：通过经验将智能体经验固化到权重中——基于验证的整合

paragraphs.en: Language-model agents use experience through external retrieval and parameter learning. Consolidating stored experience into model weights requires deciding both which experience to train on and when its external records can leave retrieval. Admission based solely on student mastery can exclude useful teacher demonstrations, while removal immediately after training can discard guidance that the model still needs. We introduce Engram , a framework that separates training admission from memory release. A demonstration-aware gate admits skills based on student mastery or sufficient successful teacher demonstrations. The student learns from selected action traces with context from an Engram Trace Graph (ETG). A verification gate then compares the updated model without episodic retrieval against the base model with retrieval on reserved probes. Release requires valid training participation and scores meeting both relative and absolute criteria; records for skills that fail verification remain retrievable. Experiments across interactive and reasoning benchmarks show consistent gains over frozen-weight ETG controls, with ablations supporting demonstration-aware admission and selective adapter activation. A controlled held-out comparison shows that verified release substantially reduces the retrievable footprint while remaining close to retain-all performance and outperforming immediate and budget-matched random release. Engram also improves task performance while reducing input-token usage and model calls. Skill-level verification further reduces retrievable experience through selective archival, retaining external guidance for skills that do not meet the release criteria. Code is available in anonymous.4open.science/r/engram-anonymous.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型智能体通过外部检索和参数学习来利用经验。 将存储的经验固化到模型权重中，需要决定训练哪些经验，以及其外部记录何时可以离开检索。 仅基于学生掌握程度的准入可能排除有用的教师示范，而训练后立即移除可能丢弃模型仍需要的指导。 我们提出 Engram，一个将训练准入与记忆释放相分离的框架。 一个示范感知门控基于学生掌握程度或足够多的成功教师示范来准入技能。 学生从选定的动作轨迹中学习，并结合来自 Engram 轨迹图（ETG）的上下文。 随后，验证门控在预留的探测任务上，比较不使用情景检索的更新模型与使用检索的基础模型。 释放要求有效的训练参与，且分数同时满足相对和绝对标准；未通过验证的技能的记录仍保持可检索。 在交互和推理基准上的实验显示，相对于冻结权重的 ETG 基线取得了一致的提升，消融实验支持了示范感知准入和选择性适配器激活。 一项受控的留出比较表明，经验证的释放大幅减少了可检索的占用，同时性能接近保留全部经验，并优于立即释放和预算匹配的随机释放。 Engram 还在降低输入 token 用量和模型调用次数的同时提升了任务性能。 技能级验证通过选择性归档进一步减少可检索经验，为不满足释放标准的技能保留外部指导。 代码可在 anonymous.4open.science/r/engram-anonymous 获取。

paragraphs.en: Language-model agents use past experience through external retrieval and parameter updates. Retrieval keeps trajectories and feedback available for future tasks, while parameter learning can make their lessons usable without consulting the original records. Combining these mechanisms raises a practical question: when has an agent learned enough from stored experience to remove the corresponding records from its retrieval memory? Retaining every record incurs storage and retrieval costs, but premature removal can discard guidance that the model still needs.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型智能体通过外部检索和参数更新来利用过去的经验。 检索将轨迹和反馈保存下来供未来任务使用，而参数学习可以使这些经验教训在不查阅原始记录的情况下也能被利用。 将这两种机制结合起来提出了一个实际问题：智能体何时才算是从存储的经验中学到了足够多的东西，从而可以将其对应的记录从检索记忆中移除？ 保留所有记录会产生存储和检索成本，但过早移除可能会丢弃模型仍然需要的指导信息。

paragraphs.en: Existing methods illustrate both approaches. Reflexion stores verbal feedback, Voyager accumulates executable skills, and MAGE organizes successful and failed experiences in a co-evolving graph ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . Self-training methods such as STaR and ReST EM instead update model parameters using selected generated solutions ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ; Singh et al., 2023 ) . An agent combining retrieval and training must distinguish useful learning material from records that are no longer needed after learning.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法同时展示了这两种途径。 Reflexion 存储文字反馈，Voyager 累积可执行的技能，而 MAGE 将成功与失败的经验组织在一个共同演化的图中（Shinn et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2023；Yang et al., 2026）。 诸如 STaR 和 ReST EM 的自训练方法则使用筛选出的生成解来更新模型参数（Zelikman et al., 2022；Singh et al., 2023）。 结合检索与训练的智能体必须区分有用的学习材料与学习之后不再需要的记录。

paragraphs.en: First, useful training experience may precede student mastery. A student can fail at prerequisite actions before reaching a more advanced skill. A stronger teacher can demonstrate that skill, but a mastery-only admission rule would still exclude it from training. Admission should therefore consider available demonstrations alongside current competence.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，有用的训练经验可能出现在学生掌握之前。 学生在达到更高级技能之前，可能会在先行动作上失败。 更强的教师可以演示该技能，但仅以掌握为标准的准入规则仍会将其排除在训练之外。 因此，准入应将现有演示与当前能力一并纳入考量。

sents.en: Admission should therefore consider available demonstrations alongside current competence.

paragraphs.en: Second, completing training does not establish that memory can be removed. A selected skill may contribute no valid training examples, or the updated model may still depend on retrieved guidance. Premature removal creates knowledge waste : external experience becomes unavailable before the weights can replace it. This can happen immediately after consolidation, independently of interference from later updates.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，完成训练并不能证明记忆可以被移除。 被选中的技能可能不提供任何有效的训练样本，或者更新后的模型可能仍然依赖检索到的指导。 过早移除会造成知识浪费：在权重能够替代外部经验之前，外部经验就变得不可用了。 这种情况可能在巩固完成后立即发生，与后续更新带来的干扰无关。

paragraphs.en: Verifying this transfer requires comparing the updated model without episodic retrieval against a retrieval-supported reference under the same task interface. Otherwise, retrieved demonstrations or differences in prompt format can obscure what the weights have learned. Action probes provide local evidence; complete rollouts and subsequent updates assess task performance and retention.

paragraphs.en: We introduce Engram , a framework that separates training admission from memory release for each skill. The Engram Trace Graph (ETG) organizes experience by skill, outcome, and source. A demonstration-aware gate admits skills with sufficient student mastery or successful teacher demonstrations. Periodic consolidation trains a low-rank adapter on valid action traces with ETG context, incorporating replay when enabled. A verification gate compares the candidate without episodic retrieval against the base model with retrieval on reserved probes. Release requires valid training participation and scores meeting both a relative threshold and an absolute floor. Approved skills use verified weights without episodic retrieval; other skills retain external guidance, optionally with a separately approved adapter. Inspired by complementary learning systems ( McClelland et al., 1995 ) , this process connects experience acquisition with parameter learning and selective memory release. Experiments across interactive and reasoning benchmarks show Engram outperforms most of baselines on multiple benchmarks. Ablations support the contributions of demonstration-aware admission and adapter activation, while showing that external guidance remains useful after training. A separate analysis illustrates how skill-level verification reduces retrievable experience through selective archival. Specifically, our contributions are:

paragraphs.en: STaR and ReST EM improve model parameters by generating, filtering, and learning from the model’s own solutions ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ; Singh et al., 2023 ) . Other methods train the behaviors that support iterative improvement: RISE learns multi-turn revision after unsuccessful attempts, while SCoRe learns self-correction through online reinforcement learning ( Qu et al., 2024 ; Kumar et al., 2024 ) . SEAL generates self-edits whose supervised updates improve downstream performance ( Zweiger et al., 2025 ) . Agent0 extends policy learning through the co-evolution of a task-generating curriculum agent and a tool-using executor ( Xia et al., 2025 ) . These methods provide mechanisms for improving an agent’s capabilities through parameter updates.

paragraphs.en: Several methods combine external experience with policy learning. EvolveR couples distilled principles with reinforcement learning, and SkillRL jointly develops a hierarchical skill library and the agent policy ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2026 ) . AgentEvolver reuses an experience pool during policy learning, while EDGE combines gain-gated distillation with utility-based experience pruning ( Zhai et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) . This combination also relates to complementary learning systems, which distinguish rapid experience storage from gradual integration into distributed representations ( McClelland et al., 1995 ) . Within this setting, Engram focuses on two decisions: when stored experience should enter training, and when its external records can be removed. Demonstration-aware admission allows learning beyond current student mastery; a separate verification gate requires training participation and compares the updated model without episodic retrieval against the base model with retrieval before authorizing removal.
paragraphs.zh: 若干方法将外部经验与策略学习相结合。 EvolveR 将提炼出的原则与强化学习相结合，而 SkillRL 则联合开发分层技能库与智能体策略（Wu et al., 2025; Xia et al., 2026）。 AgentEvolver 在策略学习过程中复用经验池，而 EDGE 则将增益门控蒸馏与基于效用的经验剪枝相结合（Zhai et al., 2025; Xie et al., 2026）。 这种组合也与互补学习系统相关，该理论区分了快速的经验存储与向分布式表征的渐进整合（McClelland et al., 1995）。 在此设定下，Engram 关注两个决策：存储的经验何时应进入训练，以及其外部记录何时可以被移除。 示例感知的准入机制使学习能够超越当前学生模型的掌握水平；一个独立的验证门要求经历训练参与，并在授权移除之前，将不借助情节检索的更新后模型与借助检索的基础模型进行比较。

paragraphs.en: We compare four release policies using the same checkpoint, initial experience store, and held-out questions: retain all, immediate release after training, verified release, and random release at a matched memory budget. We hold the adapter, prompts, retrieval configuration, and decoding settings fixed and freeze release decisions before test evaluation. This comparison isolates release-policy effects from parameter learning and adapter activation. Appendix E.1 provides the detailed protocol and uncertainty estimation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在相同的检查点、初始经验库和保留问题上比较四种发布策略：全部保留、训练后立即发布、经验证后发布，以及在匹配内存预算下随机发布。 我们固定适配器、提示词、检索配置和解码设置，并在测试评估之前冻结发布决策。 这一比较将发布策略的影响与参数学习和适配器激活分离开来。 附录 E.1 提供了详细的实验流程和不确定性估计。

paragraphs.en: On ALFWorld, Engram uses 42.8% fewer input tokens and 13.6% fewer calls than Base+ETG, but takes longer overall. SFT without inference-time ETG uses still fewer resources, while Engram improves success by 5.2 percentage points. paragraphs.en: We introduced Engram , a framework that separates training admission from verified memory release. Demonstration-aware admission enables learning beyond current student mastery, while verification determines which external records can leave retrieval. Experiments across two backbones support the framework’s effectiveness, with ablations demonstrating the benefits of parameter learning, demonstration-aware admission, and selective adapter activation. A controlled held-out comparison on HotpotQA shows that verified release retains performance close to keeping all records and outperforms immediate and budget-matched random release, supporting verification as a basis for reducing retrieval dependence. Serving evaluations further show reduced input-token usage and model calls on ALFWorld and lower latency on WebQuestions relative to Base+ETG. These findings support combining parameter learning with selective memory release to improve task performance and reduce retrieval and serving costs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Engram，一个将训练准入与经过验证的记忆释放相分离的框架。 演示感知准入使学习能够超越当前学生已掌握的内容，而验证则决定哪些外部记录可以从检索中释放。 在两个骨干模型上的实验支持该框架的有效性，消融实验展示了参数学习、演示感知准入和选择性适配器激活的收益。 在 HotpotQA 上的受控留出集对比表明，经过验证的释放能保持接近保留全部记录的性能，并优于即时释放和预算匹配的随机释放，从而支持将验证作为降低检索依赖的基础。 服务评估进一步表明，相对于 Base+ETG，在 ALFWorld 上降低了输入 token 用量和模型调用次数，并在 WebQuestions 上降低了延迟。 这些发现支持将参数学习与选择性记忆释放相结合，以提升任务性能并降低检索和服务成本。

paragraphs.en: Consolidating agent experience into model parameters can preserve sensitive information, erroneous behavior, or biases present in the training traces. Our release verification evaluates task behavior; it does not establish privacy protection, factual reliability, or safety. Removing records from retrieval also does not erase information encoded in model weights, and archived records remain stored. Applications involving sensitive data or consequential actions therefore require additional data governance, safety evaluation, and human oversight.
paragraphs.zh: 将智能体经验整合进模型参数，可能会保留训练轨迹中存在的敏感信息、错误行为或偏见。 我们的发布验证评估的是任务行为，并不能证明隐私保护、事实可靠性或安全性。 从检索中删除记录也无法抹除编码在模型权重中的信息，且已归档的记录仍会被存储。 因此，涉及敏感数据或重大后果操作的应用需要额外的数据治理、安全评估和人工监督。

paragraphs.en: Our comparisons include BALROG ( BALROG, 2026 ) , ReAct ( Yao et al., 2022b ) , Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) , Mem0 ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) , MemRL ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , EvolveR ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , SkillRL ( Xia et al., 2026 ) , EDGE ( Xie et al., 2026 ) , and MAGE ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . QA comparisons additionally include chain-of-thought prompting ( Wei et al., 2022 ) , SuRe ( Kim et al., 2024 ) , RPG ( Lyu et al., 2024 ) , EmbQA ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , and RoleRAG ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . For financial reasoning, we include adaptations based on FinQANet ( Chen et al., 2021 ) and APOLLO ( Sun et al., 2024 ) . These references identify the source methods; the reported scores come from our implementations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的对比方法包括 BALROG（ BALROG, 2026 ）、ReAct（ Yao et al., 2022b ）、Reflexion（ Shinn et al., 2023 ）、Mem0（ Chhikara et al., 2025 ）、MemRL（ Zhang et al., 2026b ）、EvolveR（ Wu et al., 2025 ）、GRPO（ Shao et al., 2024 ）、SkillRL（ Xia et al., 2026 ）、EDGE（ Xie et al., 2026 ）和 MAGE（ Yang et al., 2026 ）。 问答（QA）对比还包括思维链提示（ Wei et al., 2022 ）、SuRe（ Kim et al., 2024 ）、RPG（ Lyu et al., 2024 ）、EmbQA（ Hu et al., 2025 ）和 RoleRAG（ Zhu et al., 2025 ）。 在金融推理方面，我们加入了基于 FinQANet（ Chen et al., 2021 ）和 APOLLO（ Sun et al., 2024 ）的适配版本。 这些引用仅用于标明方法的来源；所报告的分数来自我们自己的实现。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate prompting, external-memory, and policy-learning baselines under the benchmark configurations described in Appendix B . paragraphs.en: We distinguish task-level baseline comparisons from component ablations. Baseline comparisons evaluate the implemented methods, including their respective learning and inference procedures. Component ablations use matched experience and task splits to examine individual design choices in Engram . Acquisition, training, and serving costs are accounted for separately; using the same backbone does not imply equal computational cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将任务级基线对比与组件消融区分开来。 基线对比评估所实现的方法，包括各自的学习与推理过程。 组件消融使用匹配的经验与任务划分，以考察 Engram 中各项单独的设计选择。 获取、训练与服务成本分别核算；使用相同的骨干并不意味着计算成本相同。

paragraphs.en: We distinguish experience used for acquisition and training, development data used for controller verification, and held-out data used for final evaluation. The intended unit of separation is the originating episode: segments from the same episode should remain in one partition even when they are associated with different skills. For QA, normalized questions are deduplicated across partitions before answers are attached. Question–answer matching provides an additional check rather than replacing question-level separation. The final evaluation pool is excluded from gate tuning, checkpoint selection, and prompt development.
paragraphs.zh: 我们区分用于获取和训练的经验、用于控制器验证的开发数据，以及用于最终评估的留存数据。 分割的基本单位是原始片段（episode）：即使同一片段中的段落关联不同的技能，它们也应保留在同一分区中。 对于问答（QA），在附加答案之前，先对各分区中的规范化问题进行去重。 问答匹配提供的是一种额外检查，而非取代问题层面的分割。 最终评估池被排除在门控调优、检查点选择和提示词开发之外。

sents.zh: 我们区分用于获取和训练的经验、用于控制器验证的开发数据，以及用于最终评估的留存数据。

paragraphs.en: In ALFWorld, the consolidator groups identical observation–action–prompt trajectories across skill labels, preserves the reserved groups across rounds, and excludes trajectories already present in replay. Other sequential environments reserve a deterministic tail of successful memory records per skill after sorting by node identifier. Reserved records are excluded from the current consolidation batch. Observation–action probes include up to 16 recent history entries and are subject to a probe-step cap.
paragraphs.zh: 在 ALFWorld 中，合并器会按技能标签对相同的「观察–动作–提示」轨迹进行分组，跨轮次保留预留组，并排除重放中已存在的轨迹。 其他序列环境在按节点标识符排序后，为每个技能保留成功记忆记录的确定性尾部。 预留记录会被排除在当前合并批次之外。 观察–动作探针最多包含 16 条近期历史条目，并受探针步数上限约束。

sents.zh: 在 ALFWorld 中，合并器会按技能标签对相同的「观察–动作–提示」轨迹进行分组，跨轮次保留预留组，并排除重放中已存在的轨迹。

paragraphs.en: The candidate arm uses the adapted model without episodic retrieval; the reference arm uses the base model with ETG. Both arms use the same task interface and scoring procedure. The implemented reference arm retrieves from the pre-release store. Removing a record from the training batch does not necessarily remove it from this retrieval store, so this condition is distinct from source-excluded retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: 候选组使用经适配的模型但不进行情景检索；参照组使用基础模型并配合 ETG。 两组使用相同的任务接口与评分流程。 已实现的参照组从发布前存储库中检索。 从训练批次中移除一条记录并不一定会将其从该检索存储库中移除，因此该条件与源排除检索不同。

paragraphs.en: For sequential tasks, probes measure agreement with recorded actions using the same environment prompt builder and action parser. Agreement is a local behavioral diagnostic: it can depend on the action classes represented in the probe and does not capture all valid alternative actions or subsequent environment states.
paragraphs.zh: 对于顺序任务，探针使用相同的环境提示构建器和动作解析器来衡量与记录动作的一致性。 一致性是一种局部行为诊断：它可能取决于探针中所表示的动作类别，并且无法涵盖所有有效的替代动作或后续的环境状态。

paragraphs.en: For the QA release analysis in Figure 4 , each question is counted as successful when answer F1 is at least 0.5. The skill-level score is the fraction of successful development questions. Release requires this fraction to exceed 50%, together with the relative-performance and training-evidence checks. These answer-level scores are distinct from next-action agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 对于图 4 中的 QA 发布分析，当答案 F1 至少为 0.5 时，每个问题计为成功。 技能级分数是成功的开发问题所占的比例。 发布要求该比例超过 50%，同时还要通过相对性能和训练证据检查。 这些答案级分数不同于下一动作一致性。

paragraphs.en: Paired comparisons match methods by environment world or task instance. Bootstrap draws resample the same instances for all compared methods and recompute the reported metric. For Crafter, each sampled world retains its complete achievement vector; progress or geometric score is then computed from the resulting achievement rates.
paragraphs.zh: 成对比较按环境世界或任务实例匹配各方法。 自举抽样对被比较的所有方法重采样相同的实例，并重新计算所报告的指标。 对于 Crafter，每个采样出的世界保留其完整的成就向量；随后根据由此得到的成就率计算进度分数或几何分数。

paragraphs.en: Paired differences are summarized with percentile 95% bootstrap intervals. For evaluations with multiple evolution seeds, seed-level variation is distinguished from instance-level uncertainty, with hierarchical resampling where applicable. Single-checkpoint analyses quantify variation over evaluation instances rather than variation across independently trained models. The fraction of bootstrap draws favoring a method is descriptive and is not reported as a hypothesis-test p p -value.
paragraphs.zh: 配对差值用百分位 95% 自助法区间进行汇总。 对于使用多个演化种子的评估，种子层面的变异与实例层面的不确定性被区分开来，并在适用时采用分层重抽样。 单一检查点分析量化的是评估实例上的变异，而不是独立训练模型之间的变异。 有利于某一方法的自助法抽样比例仅具描述性，不作为假设检验的 p p 值报告。

paragraphs.en: We distinguish student acquisition, teacher acquisition, verification, consolidation, and final evaluation costs. Serving measurements include all model calls and tokens used by each method, including reflection and repeated generation. Last-attempt success and best-of-attempt success are different outcomes and are identified separately when reported. Matched-data controls reuse the same acquired experience; this does not imply equal end-to-end acquisition or training cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们区分学生获取、教师获取、验证、巩固以及最终评估的成本。 服务测量包括每种方法所使用的所有模型调用和 token，包括反思与重复生成。 最后一次尝试的成功与多次尝试中的最佳成功是不同的结果，在报告时会分别标识。 匹配数据对照复用相同的已获取经验；这并不意味着端到端的获取或训练成本相等。

sents.zh: 我们区分学生获取、教师获取、验证、巩固以及最终评估的成本。

sents.en: Serving measurements include all model calls and tokens used by each method, including reflection and repeated generation.
sents.zh: 服务测量包括每种方法所使用的所有模型调用和 token，包括反思与重复生成。

sents.en: Last-attempt success and best-of-attempt success are different outcomes and are identified separately when reported.

sents.en: Matched-data controls reuse the same acquired experience; this does not imply equal end-to-end acquisition or training cost.
sents.zh: 匹配数据对照复用相同的已获取经验；这并不意味着端到端的获取或训练成本相等。

paragraphs.en: Release decisions are associated with the evaluated checkpoint and the supporting training and probe evidence. The relevant quantities include student mastery, available teacher demonstrations, realized training examples, probe size, candidate and reference scores, and the configured relative threshold and absolute floor.
paragraphs.zh: 发布决策与所评估的检查点以及配套的训练和探测证据相关联。 相关的量包括学生掌握度、可用的教师示范、已实现的训练样例、探测规模、候选与参考分数，以及所配置的相对阈值和绝对下限。

sents.zh: 发布决策与所评估的检查点以及配套的训练和探测证据相关联。

paragraphs.en: For QA, LLM-only denotes one greedy zero-shot chain-of-thought generation from the unadapted student using the question and the benchmark-supplied context, without episodic retrieval, additional search, or an adapter. Interactive controls with handcrafted strategy hints or action substitutions are identified separately rather than labeled LLM-only.
paragraphs.zh: 对于问答（QA），仅大语言模型（LLM-only）表示未经适配的学生模型仅利用问题和基准提供的上下文，进行一次贪心零样本思维链生成，不使用情景检索、额外搜索或适配器。 带有手工策略提示或动作替换的交互式控制被单独识别，而不标注为 LLM-only。

sents.en: For QA, LLM-only denotes one greedy zero-shot chain-of-thought generation from the unadapted student using the question and the benchmark-supplied context, without episodic retrieval, additional search, or an adapter.
sents.zh: 对于问答（QA），仅大语言模型（LLM-only）表示未经适配的学生模型仅利用问题和基准提供的上下文，进行一次贪心零样本思维链生成，不使用情景检索、额外搜索或适配器。

paragraphs.en: We use the fixed Qwen3-8B SFT checkpoint and the initial store of 600 HotpotQA experience records analyzed in Figure 4 . All conditions share the checkpoint, skill assignments, prompt construction, retrieval settings, and decoding configuration. No additional parameter updates are performed during this comparison. Development probes determine release decisions before held-out evaluation; test results are not used to revise these decisions or their thresholds.
